observations.start: Captain Harlan outside the Lumbridge General Store
observations.confirmed_choice: Magic gear: staff, 40 air runes, 40 mind runes (reported by a player in November 2026)
observations.model: Claim requires the completed quest flag and a ready shared cooldown; claim starts that same cooldown, which expires during ordinary route time.

observations.start: Farmer Bea's Digsite hives and adjacent Hunter field
observations.prerequisite: The Birds and the Wasps completed; unlock.beas_hunter_field set at quest completion
observations.bag_contents: Random low-level supplies are not added to the route as guaranteed resources.

observations.prerequisite: Death on the Isle complete (including base 34 Thieving)
stages: Open fancy chest in the southern wine cellar
Use icon on Statue of Ates north of Aldarin market
observations.reward: Enable fourth Pendant of Ates destination; statue drops one collectible water rune
observations.teleport_rule: A charged, untradeable pendant and one remaining frozen-tear charge are required; each teleport removes one charge. Inert pendant and tears come from chance drops, not deterministic actions in this draft.

pending_reviews: Directly observe Captain Harlan's melee and ranged choices, exact amounts and whether claiming one style changes the options or carries additional inventory restrictions. Only independently confirmed magic yields were modeled.

Current catalog validator permits XP effects only on one-time actions. Hunter XP from repeatable catches and Fletching XP from repeat dart crafting are documented here but omitted from repeated action effects to prevent incorrect one-time awards. The first wasp dart action awards its single 5 XP; add a training-aware XP model before using these actions for XP optimization.
